gate_criteria.description: V5 is the only live durable production application writer; existing and native clients share it; recovery and operational evidence is green. No dependency on deferred Phase 21
verified_points: Cutover state machine rigorously validated through all stages: PREPARED -> DRAINING -> FROZEN -> IMPORTED_AND_VERIFIED -> ARMED -> V5_AUTHORITY -> ACCEPTED.
Pre-write rollback safety proven: ABORTED_BEFORE_APPLICATION_WRITE safely restores unchanged SQLite authority if abort occurs prior to the first application write.
Post-write recovery boundary proven: after first application write, system is committed to RECOVERING_WITH_POSTGRES; restoring stale SQLite writer is strictly disallowed.
Zero split-brain invariant verified: mutual exclusion ensures writer is either SQLITE_ONLY, NO_WRITER, or POSTGRES_ONLY at all times; simultaneous writers forbidden.
Reconciliation requirement enforced: zero unexplained schema or data differences permitted across migration and verification stages.
